entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Support' or 'Sales'.
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
I need to return a VeloBand GPS Tracker. Just need to know how to do it.
I can certainly help you with that. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes. VF886-01. Look, I'm short on time. Is this something we can do quickly?

Of course. One moment while I pull up that order... Okay, I see it here. The VeloBand GPS Tracker, delivered on December 26th. Before we proceed, I just need to ask: What specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's a preference. It's not for me. Can I return it, yes or no?

Understood. I'm just checking the return eligibility now. I see it was delivered 32 days ago. For wearable electronics, there are often strict rules due to hygiene and sanitation. Let me just confirm the official policy for your specific item to make sure it's not too late...

Okay, good news. I've pulled up the knowledge base article here, and your VeloBand falls under our 10-day return policy. So yes, you are unfortunately outside the window to make a return for a full refund.
Finally. Okay, good. What do I need to do?

I'm generating your Return Merchandise Authorization now. I'll email you a prepaid shipping label and instructions. Just pack the VeloBand in its original box and drop it off at any post office. Once our warehouse receives it, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3 to 5 business days.
The email is on its way. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
